sentences.text:
Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.2353 of 2023 of Kottarakkara Police Station, Kollam District,
Vinod vs State Of Kerala on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114729947/
1 alleging commission of offences under Sections 354, 511 of 376 and 506(i) of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The allegation against the petitioner is that on 04.10.2023 at about 12 noon, with an intention and with the preparation to commit rape of the defacto complainant, the petitioner/accused, caught hold of the night dress of the defacto complainant, while she was attempting to cross a stream and when she fell down, the petitioner undressed himself and lifted her dress and pressed her on her breast and attempted to commit rape on her and thereby outraged her modesty, as well.
3.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the defacto complainant/victim are neighbours.
It is submitted that there are existing disputes between them regarding a pathway.

It is submitted that even on the day prior to the alleged date of incident, there occurred a verbal altercation between them and only for harassing the petitioner, a false complaint has been filed against the petitioner.
It is submitted that the petitioner was arrested on 05.10.2023 and he has been in custody since that date.
It is submitted that the continued detention of the petitioner is not necessary for the purpose of completing the investigation into the crime registered against the petitioner.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the grant of bail.
It is submitted that there are clear allegations against the petitioner in the first information statement of the defacto complainant.
It is submitted that the investigation conducted thus far has not shown that there are any existing civil disputes between the parties.
It is submitted that the investigation is only progressing and the grant of the bail to the petitioner at this stage may not be conducive to the completion of the investigation in a proper manner.
It is also pointed out that the petitioner is earlier involved in an offence under the provisions of the Abkari Act.

The learned Public Prosecutor also states that the petitioner is the immediate neighbour of the defacto complainant/victim and if the petitioner is granted bail at this stage, there is every chance that the defacto complainant/victim being influenced or intimidated.
Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the opinion that the petitioner can be granted bail subject to conditions.
The allegations against the petitioner are as noticed above.
The criminal antecedent mentioned against the petitioner is regarding an offence under the Abkari Act.
Continued detention of the petitioner does not appear to be necessary for the purpose of completing investigation to the crime registered against him.

The only apprehension is that since the petitioner is the immediate neighbour of the defacto complainant/victim, there is every chance that the defacto complainant/victim being influenced or intimidated by the petitioner.
That can be taken care of by imposing suitable conditions.

Therefore, the petitioner shall be released on bail subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall execute a bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
(ii) The petitioner shall report before the Investigating officer in Crime No.2353 of 2023 of Kottarakkara Police Station as and when called upon to do so.
Vinod vs State Of Kerala on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114729947/
2

(iii) The petitioner shall not enter the local limits of the Kottarakkara Police Station,
Kollam District where the defacto complainant is residing till 31.12.2023 except for the purpose of complying with condition No.(ii)
(iv) The petitioner shall not influence or intimidate the victim or any witness in Crime No.2353 of 2023 of Kottarakkara Police Station;
(v) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.
(vi) The petitioner shall not contact the victim in any manner.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.2353 of 2023 of Kottarakkara Police Station may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.

Sd/-
